Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Kreesha Turner and Samantha Jo (Samantha Win) do not share the same nationality. Samantha Win is described as "Canadian-American" in her Wikipedia entry, which explicitly states that she has Canadian nationality. Thus, both individuals share Canadian nationality, even if Samantha Win also has American nationality. The Planner failed to recognize that sharing one nationality (Canadian) is sufficient to answer "Yes" to the original question, regardless of additional nationalities.
